principle: Everything in this plugin reflects policy as of its published/verified dates. Forms, approved acronyms, competitive categories, Space Force structure, CSO priorities, and what boards value (SECWAR/SECAF/CSO priorities change with leadership and administrations) all drift. data_check.py warns when a dataset was last verified longer ago than its review window or older than the report being written; refresh from the listed source, or override per user in _opr_work/.

datasets.source: e-Publishing: DAF Form 707 (check the form date in the footer)
datasets.refresh: new form.json profile (sections, line limits, width); re-verify 201.05 mm width against a filled line

datasets.source: Built from command (FLDCOM) writing guidance: CFC Writing Guide Attachments, 26 Jun 2026 (not included)

datasets.refresh: save a new page export into Guidance/ and re-transcribe

datasets.source: USSF competitive categories / USAF developmental categories (personnel guidance, board announcements)
datasets.refresh: edit the JSON when categories are created, split, or combined
add/rename commands and deltas (e.g. SpOC -> CFC, 3 Nov 2025)

datasets.source: spaceforce.mil 'Space Force releases service-specific rank names'
Digest of CSO Selected Works (Gen Saltzman, Nov 2022 - Aug 2026); CSO Leadership Library; Gen Schiess became CSO 3 Sep 2026
datasets.refresh: add digest entries for new CSO notices and speeches; build_cso_index.py --out <local> lists missing C-Notes

datasets.source: SECWAR/SECAF/CSO guidance, board convening instructions, rating-chain knowledge
datasets.refresh: research current priorities (impact-research step) and update; user overrides in _opr_work/board_priorities.json

datasets.source: DAFI 36-2406 / SpFI 36-2401 static close-out dates (rating-chain knowledge)
datasets.refresh: edit scod.json when SCODs change; users verify each lock date with their MPF or myFSS

datasets.source: S2 Space Threat Fact Sheet (v9, updated 29 Aug 2025); canonical page spaceforce.mil Article 4297159
datasets.refresh: search for a newer edition each run; transcribe new metrics into space_threats.json with its edition and date

datasets.source: Digest of e-Publishing AFH 33-337 (DAFH when renumbered), ch 8, 19, 25-28
datasets.refresh: build_tq_index.py <new pdf> --out <local>, then update the digest (SKILL.md 'Updating the Tongue and Quill')

datasets.source: Rules paraphrased from the SpOC Writing Guide (Sep 2023), Chapter 1 (not included); CFC body not yet supplied
datasets.refresh: update writing-rules.md from the current command guide

fields.verified: when someone last confirmed it is still the current version
